description: PACE Ocean Color Instrument hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance (Rrs) product provides atmospherically corrected ocean color measurements across 340-890 nm at 5 nm spectral resolution and 1 km spatial resolution. Rrs is the fundamental ocean color measurement representing the ratio of water-leaving radiance to downwelling irradiance. The hyperspectral Rrs enables advanced ocean color applications including phytoplankton functional type discrimination, detection of harmful algal blooms, quantification of colored dissolved organic matter (CDOM), and retrieval of multiple inherent optical properties. For the Southern Ocean, the continuous spectral coverage allows better characterization of the unique optical properties of Antarctic waters, improved performance of bio-optical algorithms under extreme solar zenith angles, and detection of subtle spectral features associated with phytoplankton pigment composition. This is a Level-2 product with full hyperspectral resolution, serving as input for all higher-level PACE ocean color products.
